test_from_pandas_basic_conversion: test pl.from_pandas converts a pandas DataFrame with mixed types to a Polars DataFrame
test_from_pandas_nulls: test pl.from_pandas handles Series with empty or all-null values
test_from_pandas_nan_to_null: test pl.from_pandas converts NaN values to null when nan_to_null=True
test_from_pandas_datetime: test pl.from_pandas correctly converts pandas datetime Series to Polars datetime
test_from_pandas_index: test pl.from_pandas converts various pandas Index types including Categorical, Datetime, and Timedelta
test_from_pandas_include_index: test pl.from_pandas with include_index=True preserves pandas DataFrame index as columns
test_from_pandas_series_include_index: test pl.from_pandas with include_index=True on a pandas Series preserves its index
test_from_pandas_duplicated_columns: test pl.from_pandas raises ValueError on pandas DataFrame with non-unique column names
test_from_pandas_categorical_none: test pl.from_pandas handles pandas Categorical Series with NA values
test_from_pandas_nested_list: test pl.from_pandas converts pandas DataFrame with nested list columns
test_from_pandas_pyarrow_not_available: test pl.from_pandas succeeds when PyArrow is unavailable for supported dtypes
test_from_pandas_pyarrow_required: test pl.from_pandas raises ImportError when PyArrow is required but unavailable
test_from_pandas_string_with_natype: test pl.from_pandas handles pandas string columns containing pd.NA, np.nan, or None
